name: SirDank's Sources
subtitle: Apps by SirDank and friends
description: Sideloadable iOS apps by SirDank, plus a few third-party apps listed unmodified from their authors' GitHub releases. Add this source to AltStore, SideStore or any store that takes AltStore sources.

apps.name: SKapsule
apps.subtitle: Spiral Knights for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
Play Spiral Knights on iPhone and iPad. SKapsule runs the real desktop client on your device: a bundled Java 25 runtime, the game's OpenGL renderer translated to OpenGL ES, OpenAL audio, touch and controller support, and Web or Steam login.

Experimental. JIT is required: enable it with the built-in helper (pairing file + LocalDevVPN) or the StikDebug app. The game (about 440 MB) downloads from the official servers on first launch. Unofficial, not affiliated with Grey Havens or Three Rings.

versions.localizedDescription: Mods can no longer replace the behavior, spawn table and variant table configs. A first launch that downloads the game is no longer called a failed start. Apply Mods before the first launch asks for a launch first, and cancelling the JIT wait is no longer reported as a failure.

Adds Check for Updates. Hardens mod archive parsing, the news feed and log scrubbing. Fixes Download Modpack deleting your own mods, half-applied mods, the game being killed when you leave the app, stalled downloads, Steam login and Steam Guard issues, a built-in JIT hang, and mouse button tracking.

apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Run x86-64 Windows PC games on a jailed iPhone or iPad, using FEX-Emu, Wine and DXMT. Includes store sections for Steam, Epic, GOG, EA app and itch.io.

Third-party app by willfaust, listed here unmodified from its GitHub releases. Needs JIT (built-in pairing helper or StikDebug) and iOS 18 or later. Not made or supported by SirDank.

versions.localizedDescription: Madeira 0.2.0: GOG, EA app and itch.io stores, store tabs, Epic downloads and cloud saves.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Madeira uses the local network to pair with this device for JIT, without a computer, and to download Steam games from a PC on this network.

apps.versionDescription: Madeira 0.2.0: GOG, EA app and itch.io stores, store tabs, Epic downloads and cloud saves.

apps.name: LinuxRunner
apps.subtitle: ARM64 Linux and desktops on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Run ARM64 Linux userspace and desktop applications on iPhone and iPad, with Arch Linux ARM and other distributions, a Metal-backed virtual GPU and external display support.

Third-party app by mxhm11cr, listed here unmodified from its GitHub releases. Not made or supported by SirDank.

versions.localizedDescription: LinuxRunner 1.1.0: DeX mode for external displays, Metal GPU acceleration, more desktops.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow Linux applications to connect to computers and services on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Programs running in ios-linuxkit will be allowed to track your location in the background.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Programs running in ios-linuxkit will be allowed to track your location in the background.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Programs running in ios-linuxkit will be allowed to see your location.

apps.versionDescription: LinuxRunner 1.1.0: DeX mode for external displays, Metal GPU acceleration, more desktops.

apps.name: Henge
apps.subtitle: macOS on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
Emulate macOS on iOS and iPadOS: install macOS right on the device, no Mac needed. Early release; iPad support has not run on a real iPad yet.

Third-party app by Leviidev, listed here unmodified from its GitHub releases. Needs JIT and iOS 17 or later. Not made or supported by SirDank.
